name: HREF
description: HREF is an evaluation benchmark for instruction-following capabilities of language models, leveraging human-written responses to improve reliability and reduce bias in automatic evaluation. It contains 4,258 samples across 11 task categories and uses a composite evaluation setup selecting the most reliable method per category.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the instruction-following evaluation literature that is gaining attention, but it is not yet as widely established as long-running leaderboards like MT-Bench or AlpacaEval.
notes: Emphasizes human-written responses to improve evaluation reliability; includes a live leaderboard; covers 11 task categories.
